runtimePolicy: Aggregate inventory budget 192 MiB includes all illustrated arcade art. Mall Rat loads only the selected degen atlas plus shared mall textures; RUG.EXE loads its own enemy textures and the selected first-person weapon. Games are route-loaded and their renderers dispose GPU resources on unmount. Source PNG sheets are not loaded by gameplay. WebGL render targets and canvases are additional.
